title: EPIC — OCR: read hard images at 98/100 easy, 95/100 hard
desc: Carlo's project: an image of hard-to-read text (captchas: distortion, snow, spiderweb, split, stitch, strippy, cut, collage, corrosion, cross-shadow, darts, obstruction, dark-on-dark, many fonts) becomes an exact case-sensitive string, then typed where it belongs. The bar and the honesty rule are written in projects/superocr/JOBS.md — read that first. Three consecutive runs must clear the bar; reports are reproducible and include the failure gallery. All five strands of tonight's work are on the board: this epic, PIPELINE, GREECE, VOICE, COURSES.

history.note: all children landed or decided except S6 (00c0, barry's fixes pending). final honest picture: bars 98/95 NOT cleared — best merged reader 22% easy / 6% hard; three-run proof identical across runs; demo median 7.1s vs 10s bar met; CNN pipeline works end to end (89.2% glyph val). every failure documented, none rounded
